settings.heading: How does the SONEASE Tonsil Stones Cleaner work?
settings.content: Our device uses gentle vacuum suction to safely remove tonsil stones from the surface of your tonsils. The soft, food-grade tip and adjustable suction levels help loosen and extract buildup with minimal discomfort. Built-in LED lighting improves visibility, while the instant pause button lets you stop suction immediately for added safety and control.

settings.heading: How soon will I see results?
settings.content: Many users notice immediate relief after the first use, especially from bad breath and discomfort. For best results, regular use helps keep tonsils clear and prevent buildup over time.

settings.heading: Will my tonsil stones come back?
settings.content: They can. Tonsil stones often come back for many people, which is why having your own reusable tool at home makes it easy to manage them quickly and stay on top of your oral freshness.

settings.heading: Is this safe to use at home?
settings.content: Yes. Our tool is designed to be gentle on sensitive throat tissue. Just follow the instructions and use it slowly and carefully—many people use it safely at home every day.

settings.heading: Do I need to buy batteries?
settings.content: No, our device arrives fully charged and includes a charging cable for easy recharging whenever needed.

settings.text: A large number of bad breath cases are linked to tonsil stones—yet many people don’t even realize they have them. These tiny, odor-causing buildups sit deep in the tonsils, often out of sight and hard to detect on your own.
People who use our device often notice fresher breath within days, along with less throat discomfort and more confidence in everyday interactions.

settings.title: Improper tonsil care can lead to uncomfortable stone buildup
settings.text:
Our device is designed to gently help remove tonsil stone buildup at home. Unlike cotton swabs or other tools that can push debris deeper into the tonsils, it works to safely loosen and extract buildup from the surface.

Over time, this helps reduce causes of bad breath, throat discomfort, and that constant “something stuck” feeling.
